shortBio.en: Pearl Jam lead guitar; blues-rock solos on Alive and Even Flow.
shortBio.zh: Pearl Jam 主音吉他；Alive 与 Even Flow 上的蓝调摇滚独奏。

body.en:
Born 1966. Les Paul / Strat leads on Ten. Blues-rock vocabulary sits over Gossard rhythm and Vedder baritone—less quiet-loud than Nirvana, more open-chord hard-rock weight.

Continuous lead seat since formation.
body.zh:
1966 年生。Ten 上的 Les Paul / Strat 主音。蓝调摇滚语汇坐在 Gossard 节奏与 Vedder 男中音上——强弱动态少过 Nirvana，更偏开放和弦 hard-rock 重量。

自组建起连续主音席。
